ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 50
Logline (background for you only): Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E50.B000 [00:00.00-00:01.80] CAMERA: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.
E50.B001 [00:00.00-00:02.00] ACTION: Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
E50.B002 [00:01.80-00:07.00] CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.
E50.B003 [00:01.80-00:05.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive): A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas.
E50.B004 [00:05.80-00:07.20] ACTION: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
E50.B005 [00:07.00-00:11.80] CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.
E50.B006 [00:07.20-00:11.20] DIALOGUE FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical): A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all.
E50.B007 [00:11.80-00:15.80] CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
E50.B008 [00:12.00-00:15.50] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering): Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite.
E50.B009 [00:15.80-00:18.80] CAMERA: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
E50.B010 [00:16.80-00:18.50] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional): Name your price.
E50.B011 [00:18.80-00:26.50] CAMERA: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
E50.B012 [00:19.40-00:25.00] DIALOGUE FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding): The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.
E50.B013 [00:26.50-00:30.50] CAMERA: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
E50.B014 [00:27.20-00:30.20] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous): That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune.
E50.B015 [00:30.50-00:35.80] CAMERA: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
E50.B016 [00:31.00-00:35.00] DIALOGUE FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold): Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.
E50.B017 [00:35.80-00:39.80] CAMERA: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
E50.B018 [00:36.50-00:39.40] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating): Unsupervised. In your hands alone.
E50.B019 [00:39.80-00:43.00] CAMERA: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
E50.B020 [00:40.40-00:42.50] DIALOGUE FATHER THOMAS (Grave): For as long as it holds.
E50.B021 [00:43.00-00:48.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
E50.B022 [00:43.20-00:48.00] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing): Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does.
E50.B023 [00:48.50-00:54.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.
E50.B024 [00:49.80-00:54.00] DIALOGUE FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned): I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again.
E50.B025 [00:54.50-00:59.80] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.
E50.B026 [00:54.80-00:56.50] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Murmuring): In another room no one uses?
E50.B027 [00:56.80-00:59.20] DIALOGUE FATHER THOMAS (Whispering): Perhaps I like rooms no one uses.
E50.B028 [00:59.80-01:05.50] CAMERA: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.
E50.B029 [01:00.30-01:04.80] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Low, Carnal): Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for.
E50.B030 [01:05.50-01:10.50] CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.
E50.B031 [01:05.80-01:10.50] ACTION: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
E50.B032 [01:10.50-01:13.50] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.
E50.B033 [01:10.80-01:13.50] ACTION: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
E50.B034 [01:13.50-01:16.50] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.
E50.B035 [01:14.00-01:16.50] ACTION: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
E50.B036 [01:16.50-01:18.50] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.
E50.B037 [01:16.80-01:18.50] ACTION: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
E50.B038 [01:17.20-01:18.60] SFX: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.
E50.B039 [01:18.50-01:20.00] CAMERA: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.

Return ONLY this JSON:
{"hook_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B012", "hook_intensity": 8, "device": "insult", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}],
  "cliffhanger_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B040", "cliffhanger_tension": 7, "open_question": "string", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}]}
